column1: # The case table, one row per case in the order the harness runs them (a row
# out of order fails the gate). Column order:
#   case id <TAB> description <TAB> netcode reference decision <TAB> rocketnet decision
# "accept" is a full admission; "refuse:<class>" is a refusal with the reason
# class. The netcode column is the netcode 1.02 decision for the equivalent
# token, from the pinned mas-bandwidth/netcode source; with NETCODE_DIR the
# live answer is held to it. The rocketnet column is the decision rocketnet
# must reach; the live decision is held to it.
# replayed_token: tag v1.2.1 refuses the same connect-token MAC from a
# second address (refuse:replay). rocketnet refuses it too. rocketnet binds
# the token at response open, so the harness admits a first client through
# response open, then connects a second client holding the same token from
# another address; the request ladder refuses it (TOKEN_ALREADY_USED).
# timeout_out_of_range: netcode 1.02 admits a timeout of zero (accept).
# rocketnet refuses it (refuse:timeout). That is the rocketnet-stricter
# line, and it is within REQUIREMENTS.md. A rocketnet-weaker line is a
# finding.
valid_signature
column2: connect token with a valid signature
